headline: Data-center backlash at the ballot box hit AI-chip stocks hard, while Anthropic's IPO pricing and OpenAI's downsized raise showed capital getting pickier.

themes.title: Voters turn on the data-center buildout
themes.summary: Local ballot measures went overwhelmingly against data-center development, and on Nov 5 the semiconductor index fell about 11% with Nvidia down 9.26%. Democrats called for tighter limits, and tech firms offered concessions such as OpenAI avoiding NDAs on projects.

themes.title: Mega-valuations meet a tougher market
themes.summary: OpenAI completed an $11B portion of its raise at $1.25T, below the roughly $1.4T it sought, while buyers eyed Anthropic's IPO at as low as $1.1T and the FT reported the listing was still proceeding.

themes.title: Chips, China and Nvidia
themes.summary: AMD guided Q4 revenue to about $17B on data-center growth of 97% year on year, while about 600,000 Nvidia H200s sat in Hong Kong awaiting Beijing's approval. Reports that US intelligence believes a Chinese spy targeted Jensen Huang added a governance and export-control storyline that continued into Nov 8.

themes.title: Chinese labs ship open and multimodal models
themes.summary: Moonshot published Kimi K3.1 Pro weights on Hugging Face as promised, and Tencent released its official Hy4 with vision and computer use, saying weights and a system card would follow.
